purpose: Detect 3D depth, occlusion and parallax failures hidden by the canonical view without changing the canonical framing contract.

views.description: Left-oblique orbit view for exposing hidden depth/occlusion errors.
checks: no geometry interpenetration newly exposed by orbit
occluded critical components reveal plausible 3D continuation

views.description: Right-oblique orbit view for exposing hidden depth/occlusion errors from the opposite side.
checks: no geometry interpenetration newly exposed by orbit
occluded critical components reveal plausible 3D continuation

reproduction: Keep target/up/fov/aspect/near/far and 941x1672 DPR1 capture settings unchanged.
Orbit camera position around world Y through the declared degrees about pivot [0,0,0], preserving radius and height.
Capture each view using its id as the evidence view identifier.
acceptance_checks: exactly two non-canonical verification views are defined
each view is deterministically reproducible from canonical-camera-v1.json
left/right views are symmetric 30 degree Y-orbits
canonical camera record is not modified
